## Assessment

The game has several connected systems—creature care, discovery, breeding, DNA archiving and editing, research contracts, and turn-based battles. The main limitations I found are around how much those systems vary, rather than missing core flows:

- **Discovery is tightly constrained:** Each creature costs 60 shards and grants 4 nectar. You can choose up to three adaptations, but discovery then sets *all six* adaptation genes to high values for selected traits and low values for the rest. This limits variation in those genes between discoveries. ([src/app.js:141–156](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L141-L156))
- **Breeding has few restrictions:** Any two creatures can be paired regardless of sex, and the same pair can produce offspring repeatedly. XP is awarded only once per pair. ([src/app.js:268–281](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L268-L281))
- **Combat is turn-based but some move effects appear unused:** Moves define effects such as stagger and accuracy debuffs, but `applyMove` does not apply those effects. It does handle damage, guarding, stamina, critical hits, and the evade-style buff. Each bout also initializes fresh HP and stamina, so combat condition does not carry between bouts. ([src/dna.js:224–250](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/dna.js#L224-L250), [src/app.js:318–323](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L318-L323), [src/app.js:343–362](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L343-L362))
- **Needs decay only in habitat mode:** Hunger, energy, hygiene, and fun decrease while the game is in the habitat; the decay loop pauses in arena mode. ([src/app.js:447–450](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L447-L450), [src/dna.js:185–199](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/dna.js#L185-L199))
- **Care XP is limited:** Each care type awards XP only once per creature, though care actions can still be repeated for their needs effects. ([src/app.js:125–130](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js#L125-L130))

## Run and test

From the project directory:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Vite serves the development app on port **3002**. To check a production build:

```bash
npm run build
npm run preview
```

`package.json` defines `dev`, `build`, and `preview`, but **no test script**. I also found no test/spec files, so there is no automated test suite or documented test command to run. The README is an autogenerated project landing page rather than gameplay or testing documentation. ([package.json:6–9](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json#L6-L9), [README.md:1–18](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md#L1-L18))

- Finish Helix Forge as a complete, playable game.
- Update ability and genome displays to use graphics instead of text.

## Decisions
- Battle stagger skips the affected creature’s next action; accuracy debuffs reduce its next attack’s accuracy.
- Keep a guaranteed defensive move available even when a creature has many strike abilities.
- Prevent changing the active creature while a battle is in progress.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented stagger and accuracy-debuff battle effects, including effect indicators in the battle HUD.
- Ensured a defensive ability remains available in the move list.
- Prevented roster selection during arena mode; arena UI updates roster disabled state.

- Changes are uncommitted.

- Accuracy debuffs persist until the creature’s next attack; defensive actions and stamina recovery do not consume them.

## Objective
- Finish Helix Forge as a complete, playable game.
- Show abilities and genome graphically instead of relying on text-heavy displays.

## Requirements
- Retain clear labels and accessibility while making the displays graphic-forward.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when reporting completion.
- If taking screenshots for checks, save small JPEGs no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Battle stagger skips the affected creature’s next action; accuracy debuffs reduce its next attack’s accuracy.
- Keep a guaranteed defensive move available even when a creature has many strike abilities.
- Prevent changing the active creature while a battle is in progress.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented stagger and accuracy-debuff battle effects, including effect indicators in the battle HUD.
- Ensured a defensive ability remains available in the move list.
- Prevented roster selection during arena mode; arena UI updates roster disabled state.
- Added guards for leaving the arena during attack animations.
- Updated `renderGenome` with a chromosome map, gene glyphs, and paired-allele visual bars.
- Updated `renderAbilities` with graphic metric bars for power, accuracy, cost, or recovery, plus effect indicators.

### Active
- Add CSS styling for the new genome and ability graphics.
- Verify the updated displays and run project checks.

### Blocked
- No browser gameplay test tooling or test scripts were found.

## Next Move
1. Add responsive styles for the chromosome map, gene visuals, ability spectrum, and metric cards in `src/style.css`.
2. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; review generated `dist/` changes and revert build artifacts if appropriate.
3. Check the displays in a browser if tooling is available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `renderGenome` and `renderAbilities` now render graphic-forward markup.
- `src/style.css`: existing profile and genome styles; add styles for the new graphics here.
- `src/dna.js`: genome traits and ability definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Earlier `npm run build` succeeded with Vite’s warning that the minified JS chunk exceeds 500 kB; generated `dist/` changes were reverted.
- Accuracy debuffs persist until the creature’s next attack; defensive actions and stamina recovery do not consume them.

- Finish Helix Forge as a complete, playable game.
- Make abilities and the genome graphic-forward while retaining clear labels and accessibility.

- Keep the displays understandable and accessible, not text-only.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when reporting completion.

- Battle stagger skips the affected creature’s next action; accuracy debuffs lower its next attack’s accuracy.
- Keep a guaranteed defensive move available, and prevent changing the active creature or leaving the arena during battle animations.

- Finish Helix Forge as a complete, playable game, with graphic-forward abilities and genome displays that remain clear and accessible.

## Objective
- Complete Helix Forge as a playable game with clear, accessible genome and ability displays.
- Add an uncapped battle challenge road with random-DNA enemies, increasing difficulty, and a boss every ten levels.

## Requirements
- Keep displays understandable and accessible, not text-only.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when reporting completion.
- Challenge enemies should have totally random DNA; difficulty should increase each level; every tenth level should have a boss.

## Decisions
- Battle stagger skips the affected creature’s next action; accuracy debuffs lower its next attack’s accuracy.
- Keep a guaranteed defensive move available; prevent switching creatures or leaving during battle animations.
- Endless road saves progress, gives the player partial HP/stamina recovery between wins, and allows retrying a failed level.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented battle stagger and accuracy-debuff effects, HUD indicators, defensive move availability, and arena roster/exit guards.
- Updated genome and ability displays with visual maps, glyphs, expressed values, metric bars, and effect indicators.
- Added an endless-road entry point, randomly generated wild opponents, increasing enemy health/damage, tenth-level Apex bosses, road rewards, saved level progression, and win/defeat/retry/continue UI.
- `npm run build` passed before the latest small change to road-level saving; `git diff --check` passed.
- Restored generated `dist/` output after building.

### Active
- Verify the last road-progression change with a build and review challenge gameplay flow.

### Blocked
- Browser gameplay tooling and test scripts were not available.

2. Review the road progression and boss scaling in gameplay if browser tools become available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Road challenge UI, progression, enemy generation/scaling, battle rewards and transitions.
- `src/dna.js`: Random genome generation and battle creature stats/moves.
- `src/style.css`: Road challenge and result UI styling.

## Important Context
